patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with alternating dark, rich background colors and a central content column, creating distinct visual breaks and a strong sense of progression down the page.
A sophisticated display serif font is used for large, expressive headings, creating an elegant and editorial feel, contrasted with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and functional elements.

A dominant dark background palette (black, deep purples, teals, blues) is punctuated by vibrant, jewel-toned accent colors for section backgrounds and subtle highlights, with white text for high contrast.
Sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport. The navigation bar remains sticky at the top, and client logos are presented in a horizontal carousel.

The 'There are 3 ways we help' section features a unique multi-column layout with embedded image grids, each column having a distinct background color, creating a dynamic visual breakdown of services.

technique_notes: Implement scroll-triggered animations using GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate staggered fade-ins and slide-ups for content blocks and sections as they become visible. The main navigation should be sticky, with a state change (e.g., adding a solid background and reducing height) after a certain scroll threshold. Utilize Swiper.js for interactive horizontal carousels, specifically for the client logo display. The hero section can incorporate a video loop or a subtle parallax effect on its background image to add depth.

Design full-width sections with generous vertical padding, ensuring content is centered within a constrained maximum width for readability. Use a dark base palette with vibrant, deep accent colors for section backgrounds and occasional text highlights. Pair a sophisticated display serif font for large headings with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text, ensuring high contrast against dark backgrounds.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (hero ~3-4x body) with a clear hierarchy down to legible sans-serif body text, maintaining strong contrast.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, consistent corner-radius (e.g., 4-8px) applied to buttons, cards, and image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between full-bleed sections and a more balanced density within content grids.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a rich, deep, jewel-toned color palette against dark backgrounds, combined with elegant serif typography and dynamic, illustrative imagery, creates a sophisticated and high-end brand presence. The multi-column '3 ways we help' section with its embedded image grids and varied background colors is particularly unique, offering a visually engaging way to present services.
